C.domain: Subtracting fractions and mixed numbers (including regrouping and simplification)

skills.name: Common denominator conversion
skills.definition: Find a least common denominator (LCD) and rewrite one or both fractions as equivalent fractions with that denominator.
inclusion_criteria: Solution explicitly finds an LCD/LCM for two denominators
Solution converts fractions to equivalent forms with a common denominator before subtracting
exclusion_criteria: Fractions already share a denominator and no conversion is performed
Only rewriting a whole number as a fraction with a chosen denominator (tag S03 instead)

skills.name: Subtract aligned fractions
skills.definition: Subtract quantities once they are in compatible form (same denominator or separated whole/fraction parts) by subtracting numerators and/or whole-number parts and combining the result.
inclusion_criteria: Subtracts numerators over a common denominator (e.g., a/b − c/b)
Subtracts whole parts and fraction parts separately and then combines
Computes the final difference after any needed conversions are already done
exclusion_criteria: The main work is converting to a common denominator (tag S01 as well)
The main work is borrowing/regrouping because the fractional part is negative (tag S04 as well)
The main work is simplifying/reducing the result (tag S03 as well)

skills.name: Rewrite and simplify
skills.definition: Rewrite numbers into an equivalent form (e.g., mixed↔improper, whole→fraction with a specified denominator) and/or reduce a fraction to lowest terms (including simplifying to an integer).
inclusion_criteria: Converts a mixed number to an improper fraction or interprets a nonstandard mixed form as a sum
Rewrites a whole number as a fraction with a chosen denominator (e.g., 4 = 12/3)
Reduces a fraction (e.g., 9/12 → 3/4) or simplifies 0/n → 0
exclusion_criteria: Only finding an LCD and converting both fractions to that denominator (tag S01 instead)
Only subtracting after forms are already compatible, with no rewriting/simplifying step shown (tag S02 instead)

skills.name: Borrow/regroup in subtraction
skills.definition: Regroup by borrowing 1 from the whole-number part (or rewriting a whole as a mixed form) to make the fractional subtraction nonnegative, then continue the subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: Fractional part subtraction produces a negative result and the solution borrows 1 from the whole part
Adds a full unit fraction (e.g., 5/5, 12/12, 24/24) after decreasing the whole part by 1
exclusion_criteria: No borrowing/regrouping is performed (even if the result is negative overall)
Only converting to improper fractions and subtracting directly without a borrow step

B.domain: Subtracting fractions and mixed numbers (including improper fractions), with simplification and regrouping

skills.name: Common denominator conversion
skills.definition: Find a least common denominator (LCD) and rewrite one or both fractions as equivalent fractions with that denominator.
inclusion_criteria: Solution explicitly finds an LCD/LCM for two denominators
Solution converts fractions to equivalent forms with a common denominator before subtracting
Solution converts only the fractional parts of mixed numbers to a common denominator
exclusion_criteria: Fractions already share a denominator and the work only subtracts numerators
Work only rewrites a whole number as a fraction with a chosen denominator (tag S03 instead)
Work only reduces/simplifies a fraction (tag S04 instead)

skills.name: Subtract fraction parts
skills.definition: Perform the subtraction once denominators match, including subtracting numerators and combining whole and fractional parts when written separately.
inclusion_criteria: Subtracts two like-denominator fractions by subtracting numerators
Subtracts fractional parts of mixed numbers (after ensuring like denominators)
Combines the resulting whole and fractional parts into a single value (mixed number, fraction, or integer)
exclusion_criteria: The main action is finding an LCD and converting (tag S01 instead)
The main action is borrowing/regrouping because the fractional result is negative (tag S03 instead)
The main action is simplifying/reducing the final fraction (tag S04 instead)

skills.name: Regroup whole and fraction
skills.definition: Rewrite or regroup whole/mixed numbers to enable subtraction, including borrowing 1 whole into fractional units or converting mixed/whole numbers to equivalent fractional forms.
inclusion_criteria: Borrows/regroups from the whole part to fix a negative fractional subtraction (e.g., add b/b after reducing the whole by 1)
Rewrites a whole number as an equivalent mixed number or fraction with a specified denominator (e.g., 2 = 1 3/3 or 4 = 12/3)
Converts a mixed number (including nonstandard forms like 1 5/3) into an improper fraction before subtracting
exclusion_criteria: Only finds an LCD and converts two proper/improper fractions (tag S01 instead)
Only subtracts like-denominator fractions without any borrowing or rewriting of whole numbers (tag S02 instead)
Only reduces a fraction to lowest terms (tag S04 instead)

skills.name: Simplify to lowest terms
skills.definition: Reduce a fraction (or a zero fraction) to lowest terms and/or express the final result in simplest acceptable form (integer, proper fraction, or mixed number).
inclusion_criteria: Simplifies a fraction by dividing numerator and denominator by a common factor
Simplifies a zero fraction to 0
Converts an improper fraction result to a mixed number as part of final simplification
exclusion_criteria: Only performs the subtraction without any reduction or final-form simplification
Only rewrites numbers to enable subtraction (tag S03 instead)

A.domain: Subtracting fractions and mixed numbers (including regrouping/borrowing) and simplifying results

skills.name: Common denominator conversion
skills.definition: Find a least common denominator (LCD) and rewrite one or both fractions as equivalent fractions with that denominator.
inclusion_criteria: Solution explicitly finds an LCD/LCM for two denominators
Solution converts fractions to equivalent forms with a shared denominator before subtracting
Solution converts only the fractional parts of mixed numbers to a common denominator
exclusion_criteria: Fractions already share a denominator and the work only subtracts numerators
Work only rewrites a whole number as a fraction with a chosen denominator (tag S03 instead)
Work only reduces/simplifies a fraction (tag S04 instead)

skills.name: Subtract and combine parts
skills.definition: Perform the subtraction once terms are in compatible form (like denominators or separated whole/fraction parts) and combine to state the result.
inclusion_criteria: Subtracts numerators over a common denominator (including like-denominator cases)
Subtracts whole parts and fraction parts separately for mixed/whole-number expressions
Combines whole and fractional results into a single number (fraction, mixed number, or integer)
exclusion_criteria: Work is primarily about finding a common denominator (tag S01 instead)
Work is primarily about borrowing/regrouping because the fractional part is negative (tag S03 instead)
Work is only simplifying/reducing the final fraction (tag S04 instead)

skills.name: Regroup whole and fraction
skills.definition: Rewrite numbers to enable subtraction by converting between mixed/improper forms or borrowing 1 whole into fractional units when the fractional subtraction would be negative.
inclusion_criteria: Borrows/regroups from the whole part (e.g., subtract 1 from whole and add denominator/denominator to the fraction)
Rewrites a whole number as a mixed number with a fractional part (e.g., 2 = 1 3/3)
Converts a mixed number (including nonstandard ones like 1 4/3) into an improper fraction to proceed
exclusion_criteria: Only finds LCD and converts equivalent fractions (tag S01 instead)
Only performs straightforward subtraction with no regrouping/rewriting needed (tag S02 instead)
Only reduces a fraction to lowest terms (tag S04 instead)

skills.name: Simplify to lowest terms
skills.definition: Reduce fractions (including zero fractions) to lowest terms and express the final value in an acceptable simplified form (integer, proper/improper fraction, or mixed number).
inclusion_criteria: Cancels a common factor in numerator and denominator to reduce a fraction
Simplifies a zero fraction to 0
Converts an improper fraction result to a mixed number (or confirms an integer result) as the final simplified expression
exclusion_criteria: Only performs subtraction without any reduction or final-form simplification
Only rewrites to enable subtraction (tag S03 instead)
Only finds LCD and converts equivalent fractions (tag S01 instead)
